answer: Price the cheap path. Every identity posts 200 POA and holds it for 16 epochs, and any attestation from a subnet that already signed for another identity pays a 15% tax. At 200 POA and 16 epochs a 1,000 clone oasis locks 200,000 POA for four days. The ridge between honest cost and attack cost is the only number that matters. A summit reached by paying more is not an attack.
